title: Basket
tagline: Basket: stablecoin-as-a-service for the creation of compliant, oracle-backed stablecoins
description: Basket is a decentralized stablecoin infrastructure platform that enables anyone to create compliant, oracle-backed stablecoins through a permissionless factory smart contract. Unlike traditional stablecoins with centralized admin minting, Basket enforces all compliance and reserve requirements on-chain using Chainlink's Advanced Compliance Engine (ACE) for policy enforcement and Chainlink's Composable Reserve Engine (CRE) for cryptographic Proof-of-Reserve validation. This eliminates trust assumptions and creates a transparent, auditable stablecoin issuance system.
how_its_made: Basket uses a factory pattern to deploy new stablecoin contracts on demand, wiring each one to oracle feeds for pricing and reserve verification. We combine on-chain governance, automated rebalancing, and cross-chain messaging to create stablecoins that are transparent, composable, and portable. The frontend abstracts complex DeFi mechanics into a simple creation wizard, turning stablecoin design into a few clicks while preserving on-chain trust guarantees.
